_about: The skill's statistical layer: web AI-text detectors it runs through Claude in Chrome, in the user's own browser session, chunk by chunk. 'weight' says how grade.py treats a tool: 'validated' tools have independent evidence of a low false-positive rate and can count as a line of evidence; 'context' tools are reported but never raise the verdict above weak. Free-tier limits change: read them on the page, never work around them. Pasting text into these sites uploads it: only for text the user owns or co-authors, or public text (SKILL.md, step 2b).

tools.name: Pangram
tools.evidence: Near-zero false positives and robust to humanizers in the University of Chicago study (Jabarian & Imas 2025, NBER w34223); the only tool meeting a 0.5% FPR cap there.
tools.read: Record the AI likelihood as 0-1 and the label shown (e.g. 'AI', 'Mixed', 'Human'). If it reports AI share by segment, record the overall share.

automation.status: CAPTCHA (Cloudflare) on automated use; needs the user to tick it

tools.api: api_detectors.py (PANGRAM_API_KEY; free research credits on application at https://pangram.com/solutions/api)

tools.name: GPTZero
tools.evidence: False-positive rate under 1% in the University of Chicago study; 0% FPR at its default threshold on the RAID benchmark (Dugan et al. 2024).
tools.read: Record the probability that the text is AI-generated (0-1) and the classification shown ('AI', 'Mixed', 'Human').

automation.status: hCaptcha before results (opens a new tab at app.gptzero.me); needs the user

tools.api: api_detectors.py (GPTZERO_API_KEY; paid; ask for research credits)

tools.name: Originality.ai
tools.evidence: False-positive rate under 1% in the University of Chicago study; 0.25% FPR at its default threshold on RAID. Mostly paid; use only if the free checker works.
tools.read: Record the 'AI' confidence (0-1).

automation.status: CAPTCHA on automated use; needs the user

tools.evidence: No independent peer-reviewed false-positive rate found.
tools.read: Record the AI score (0-1) or 0/1 from the label.

tools.name: Grammarly AI Detector
tools.evidence: Vendor-submitted RAID entry (2026-02): 0.995 detection at 5% FPR, 0.982 at 1% FPR; self-submitted and possibly tuned to RAID; no peer-reviewed evaluation.
tools.read: Record the share of text reported as AI-generated (0-1).

automation.status: one anonymous scan works; then a sign-up wall (a free account removes it: sign in once with browser_detect.py --login)

tools.name: Binoculars (demo)
tools.evidence: Published zero-shot method (Hans et al., ICML 2024); RAID 0.79 detection at 5% FPR, 0.695 at 1% FPR (no attacks). The demo returns a decision, not a probability.
tools.read: api_detectors.py records 1 for 'AI' and 0 for 'human'.

automation.status: works through the API without a key (Gradio 4 endpoint /call/run_detector)

tools.name: Clever AI Detector
tools.evidence: Vendor claim 96.7% (GEDE); one non-peer-reviewed test caught 3/10 edited AI texts. No independent evidence.
tools.read: Record the AI likelihood or AI share shown (0-1).

automation.status: Terms §6.3 forbid robots/scripts: the skill never runs it automatically; the user may paste chunks by hand.

_max_words_note: max_words: the most text a site accepts per check on its free tier, when known. Unknown values are null: read the limit on the page; watch.py's monthly scan fills them in.
_terms_note: 'terms': 'no-automation' marks sites whose terms forbid scripted access. browser_detect.py never runs them; the skill may open the page for the user to paste a chunk by hand.
